artifacts.notes: Complete six-stanza, sixty-line poem plus its epigraph. The derivative’s line and stanza breaks are mechanically taken from the scholarly page; it does not assert a facsimile collation or a critical text independent of that edition.
artifacts.rights_basis: Keats’s nineteenth-century poem and biblical epigraph are public domain in the United States by publication date. This derivative retains only that underlying wording, without the modern G. Kim Blank site apparatus or licensed presentation.

artifacts.notes: Complete scholarly poem page, epigraph plus all 60 numbered lines in six stanzas I–VI, with edition/date/creator citation footer. No fuller single-poem download is linked on this page. Modern presentation license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
artifacts.rights_basis: The site identifies G. Kim Blank and CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for its modern presentation. Those restrictions are kept distinct from the public-domain Keats poem and do not become Triptych’s CC BY 4.0 grant. Exact HTML is withheld; the separately retained poem text omits the modern apparatus and rests on the underlying poem’s United States public-domain status.
